comment: Master declaration for the manifold fleet (#418). Git, not the vault, owns hub discovery: changing the master is a reviewed commit, so vault write access can never repoint fleet terminals. The owner key stays in Bitwarden under vaultItemName and is read only by the one-time interactive `atyrode runtime provision manifold-agent`; the running agent needs only its 0600 machine token file. supportedSystems mirrors the release-asset platforms published by atyrode/manifold's Release workflow (pinned in pkgs/manifold-agent); widen it only as upstream publishes more assets.
